'''Pomegrail''' was a substance that gave off a noticeable odor.<ref name="Shadows" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jax Pavan]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] turned [[Detective/Legends|investigator]], noticed that [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]] smelled slightly of pomegrail when they met inside of the baron's [[Vlaçan Umber's apartment|apartment]], which was located in the [[Manarai Hills]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Pavan was unable to tell if the smell was naturally occurring or artificial in nature.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pomegrail first appeared as a smell in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' {{1st}} {{C|Smell only}}
